providerPricesPerMillionTokensPublishedR: Provider prices per million tokens. Published rates apply to new requests. One point = ¥0.10; successful solver calls cost one point.
blockedInputIsRejectedWithoutChargeMatch: Blocked input is rejected without charge; matching streamed text is masked. Patterns support ? for one character. Allow phrases exempt only their matching spans. Image semantics are not moderated by this basic filter.
deepseekPeakMondayFriday0912And14: DeepSeek peak: Monday–Friday, 09–12 and 14–18 Beijing time. Exact amounts are summed before rounding credits to four decimal places.
newRequestsWillUseThisConfigurationInFli: New requests will use this configuration. In-flight requests retain their original version. Gateway sync status is shown above.
